consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 10/02/1994 show at Boston Garden was enjoyable but lacked the energy and standout moments of the previous night's performance. While some songs were praised, many felt the overall performance was flat compared to the excitement of the previous show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 15 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there were some highlights, many reviewers felt the performance lacked energy and did not live up to the previous night's show.
